title: The passive with se: what was created

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *se* from B1 Unit 6 (*se venden casas*, *se abrió una tienda*). The verb agrees with the thing that was made, and nobody is named as the doer. It is the natural way to say what was created after independence.

sections.title: Se + verb
rows: singular noun, singular verb: a flag was created
plural noun, plural verb: anthems were created
the noun can come first: the anthem was approved

items.spanish: Se crearon muchos himnos después de la independencia.
items.english: Many anthems were created after independence.

items.spanish: El himno mexicano se cantó por primera vez en 1854.
items.english: The Mexican anthem was sung for the first time in 1854.

items.spanish: Se hicieron estatuas y monumentos de héroes.
items.english: Statues and monuments of heroes were made.

sections.content: The verb agrees with the noun, not with the person: *se creó una bandera*, *se crearon banderas*. Do not write *se creó banderas*. Use the preterite for a single event (*se aprobó en 1813*) and the imperfect for what happened every year (*se celebraban*).
